scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web-react"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web-react && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile && npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/data && npm run typecheck -w packages/tokens
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/data && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w packages/tokens
